blocks.text: What is a "call"? It's the divine assignment you were born with - a task meant to be carried out in step with the growth of God's Kingdom on earth - {{jr 1:5|Jeremiah 1:5}}, {{gl 1:15|Galatians 1:15}}. Your call is proportionate to your gifting and potential - {{1co 12:6|1 Corinthians 12:6}}.

What is a "ministry"? It's the department or office through which your call is actually carried out - {{1co 12:5|1 Corinthians 12:5}}. It's not necessarily a title, but a place of service in God's vineyard.
